settings.title: Settings
settings.saidHint: Show what each terminal was last told to run beside its mark, rather than only while Ctrl is held.
settings.revealHint: How far the canvas moves to keep the commit the cursor keys reached in view.
settings.followHint: Fetch every few minutes, and take branches that are only behind up to their remote end.
settings.fetchHint: Do that round once, on every repository, without waiting for the next one — and whether or not the window is following.
settings.fetchFailedHint: A remote would not answer. Everything that did has been taken.
settings.registerHint: Written into each agent once, and read by every terminal it is run in.
settings.saidFit: Fit the lines to the canvas
settings.saidFitHint: Take how wide a line may be from how much of the canvas is on screen, and how many lines it may run to from how far apart the graph's rows are.

update.title: Updates
update.readyHint: The release is here. This window closes and opens again on it; every terminal stays where it is.
update.adjustFailed: Could not adjust to the selected version
update.incompatible: That version is unavailable or incompatible
update.stays: A patch on line {{line}}: the program holding the terminals stays, and so does every terminal.
update.moves: Line {{line}} is another program holding the terminals. Every terminal is closed to put it in.
update.persistentBehind: This window brought {{version}}. Restart puts it in; every terminal is closed.
update.persistentLine: The program holding the terminals. A patch never replaces it; a minor does.
update.persistentMove: Stops the program holding the terminals and starts {{version}} in its place. Every terminal is closed.
